items.title: Gen Z Embraces Crypto While Most Americans Call It a 'Side Quest'
items.snippet: A SoFi and YouGov survey found that 21% of Gen Z adults own crypto, more than hold employer retirement plans, even as only 13% of all Americans own it and most remain skeptical.

items.snippet: The global securities watchdog said markets shouldn't wait for quantum computers to arrive, flagging bulkier signatures and harder upgrades.
